definition: Bridges business stakeholders and technical teams by translating business problems into clear technology requirements.
Advises organizations on technology choices, digital transformation, implementation approaches, and improvement opportunities.
Specifies, validates, traces, and controls functional and non-functional requirements for software products or systems.
Analyzes how information systems work and translates business needs into system, data, interface, and workflow requirements.
Designs and integrates end-to-end computing systems spanning hardware, operating systems, software, networks, storage, and reliability.
Aligns enterprise-wide business capabilities, applications, data, infrastructure, and technology investments with organizational strategy.
Designs a practical technical solution for a specific business problem, product, program, or project.
Defines the technical structure of complex infrastructure and systems across compute, networking, storage, identity, availability, and operations.
Connects applications, services, databases, devices, and third-party platforms into reliable end-to-end workflows.
Operates and supports cloud accounts, identities, infrastructure resources, access, backups, monitoring, and routine cloud services.
Designs secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-aware cloud or hybrid-cloud architectures.
Implements, automates, deploys, and operates cloud infrastructure and cloud-native services.
Automates software delivery and improves collaboration between development and operations teams.
Builds internal platforms that give engineering teams secure, standardized, self-service ways to build, deploy, and operate software.
Coordinates and automates controlled software releases across environments, versions, teams, and change processes.
Applies software engineering to ensure production services are reliable, scalable, observable, and efficiently operated.
Runs and monitors production computing jobs, consoles, batch schedules, and operational workflows.
Operates physical data-centre facilities, servers, racks, cabling, power, cooling, and environmental infrastructure.
Designs, tests, and maintains technical capabilities for recovering systems and data after outages or disasters.
Designs, operates, optimizes, and protects block, file, and object-storage systems.
Improves the environmental efficiency of IT infrastructure, cloud use, hardware lifecycle, and digital operations.
Installs, configures, secures, patches, monitors, and supports server, identity, endpoint, and core infrastructure environments.
Controls system configuration items, baselines, desired-state configurations, change records, and configuration compliance.
Deploys, maintains, secures, and monitors web servers, websites, domains, certificates, and CMS environments.
Designs and evaluates computer hardware, boards, processors, storage, interfaces, and electronic subsystems.
Builds, installs, repairs, calibrates, and documents computing hardware under engineering procedures.
Executes test plans for hardware components and systems, records failures, and supports quality validation.
Designs integrated hardware/firmware systems for devices that operate under physical, real-time, power, and communication constraints.
Integrates security practices and controls into software design, development, testing, and delivery.
Designs, configures, automates, and monitors security controls in cloud environments.
Designs, evaluates, implements, or integrates cryptographic algorithms, protocols, PKI, certificates, and key-management systems.
Secures connected devices, firmware, hardware interfaces, device identity, and device-to-cloud communication.
Designs and operates authentication, authorization, federation, provisioning, privileged access, and identity governance services.
Designs, implements, and operates network-security controls that protect communications and control access.
Administers security tools, endpoint controls, access controls, policies, scans, and routine security operations.
Defines enterprise security patterns, target-state designs, guardrails, reference architectures, and security technology standards.
Implements and maintains technical security controls across infrastructure, cloud, endpoints, networks, applications, and security platforms.
Advises organizations on cybersecurity strategy, posture, risk, controls, transformation, and regulatory alignment.
Operates governance, risk, and compliance processes, frameworks, control assessments, and risk reporting.
Manages privacy compliance and data-protection controls for personal, sensitive, and regulated information.
Independently evaluates technology controls, audit evidence, access controls, change processes, and compliance with audit standards.
Maintains continuous adherence to technology regulations, certifications, contractual obligations, and control requirements.
Investigates, contains, eradicates, and recovers from active cybersecurity incidents.
Produces actionable intelligence on threat actors, campaigns, vulnerabilities, tactics, techniques, and indicators.
Monitors security events, triages alerts, investigates suspicious activity, and escalates confirmed threats.
Preserves, extracts, and analyzes digital evidence from disks, memory, mobile devices, cloud logs, and systems.
Performs authorized adversarial testing to identify and demonstrate exploitable security weaknesses.
Identifies, prioritizes, tracks, and validates vulnerabilities across assets and environments.
Builds and integrates AI-enabled applications, including predictive systems, generative AI, RAG solutions, agents, and intelligent automation.
Builds systems that understand images and video for detection, classification, segmentation, OCR, and visual analytics.
Structures and manages knowledge through taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs, rules, and semantic models.
Builds, deploys, monitors, and maintains production machine-learning pipelines and services.
Builds systems that analyze, extract, search, classify, generate, or translate human language.
Creates dashboards, reporting, KPIs, and business insights from organizational data.
Builds data models, reporting layers, dashboards, semantic models, and BI delivery pipelines.
Collects, cleans, queries, analyzes, and visualizes data to answer business or operational questions.
Defines, measures, improves, and governs data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and reliability.
Transforms warehouse data into tested, documented, analyst-ready models and semantic layers.
Defines the organization’s data architecture, data models, platform strategy, integration patterns, and data standards.
Builds and operates pipelines that ingest, transform, store, stream, and deliver data at scale.
Establishes data ownership, policies, metadata, lineage, cataloging, classification, and stewardship practices.
Builds and maintains warehouse schemas, dimensions, facts, transformations, stored procedures, and reporting-ready data stores.
Investigates new computing methods, algorithms, systems, architectures, or scientific computing techniques.
Uses statistics, machine learning, experiments, and visualization to derive insights and predictive models from data.
Researches and develops novel machine-learning methods, models, optimization techniques, and evaluation approaches.
Operates, secures, backs up, restores, patches, and tunes production database platforms.
Defines database platform strategy, standards, scalable data-store designs, availability patterns, and database security architecture.
Builds database objects and application data access logic, including schemas, SQL, stored procedures, and migrations.
Connects databases with applications, APIs, enterprise systems, migration tools, and data pipelines.
Applies computing, statistics, and data methods to biological and genomic data.
Manages, analyzes, and visualizes geographic and spatial data for maps, location intelligence, and geospatial applications.
Improves health-information systems, clinical data interoperability, health analytics, and digital healthcare workflows.
Organizes, governs, digitizes, stores, retrieves, retains, and automates enterprise documents and records.
Provides technical, customer-facing guidance to support adoption, service health, product use, escalations, and account outcomes.
Produces accurate and usable technical documentation for products, platforms, APIs, systems, and users.
Designs and delivers technical learning programs, hands-on labs, courses, assessments, and adoption training.
Supports business applications in production through incident resolution, SQL/log analysis, configuration, user support, and escalation.
Installs, repairs, upgrades, tests, and maintains end-user computers, peripherals, and related physical devices.
Supports end-user desktop environments, endpoints, productivity tools, identity access, mobile devices, and local connectivity.
Provides first-line technical support, triage, standard requests, and user guidance through ticketing, phone, chat, or email channels.
Resolves complex user, application, infrastructure, endpoint, and operational support issues while automating recurring support work.
Maintains daily operation of network devices, connectivity, addressing, wireless, access, monitoring, and routine network services.
Designs scalable, resilient, secure network architectures across campus, data centre, WAN, cloud, wireless, and remote-access environments.
Deploys, configures, automates, troubleshoots, and improves production network infrastructure.
Provides operational support for connectivity problems, user network issues, monitoring alerts, and network-service incidents.
Installs and maintains physical network infrastructure, cabling, network-edge equipment, access points, and basic device configurations.
Analyzes telecom services, carriers, voice/data usage, call quality, costs, contracts, inventories, and service levels.
Designs, integrates, tests, optimizes, and supports voice, video, mobile, carrier, fibre, and communication-network systems.
Owns product direction, prioritization, roadmap, user value, and product outcomes for a digital or IT product.
Plans and governs IT project delivery across scope, schedule, budget, risks, resources, dependencies, and stakeholders.
Facilitates Scrum/agile practices and helps teams improve flow, collaboration, delivery discipline, and continuous improvement.
Defines game mechanics, levels, systems, progression, narrative, economy, and player experience.
Designs end-to-end user experiences, flows, interactions, information architecture, and prototypes.
Studies user behavior, needs, motivations, and usability through qualitative and quantitative research.
Designs visual interface systems, high-fidelity screens, reusable components, responsive states, and UI specifications.
Designs and often builds responsive, brand-aligned websites and webpages using web technologies and CMS/no-code tools.
Builds, tests, releases, and maintains Android applications.
Builds server-side applications, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, and business logic.
Builds cloud-native applications using managed services, serverless functions, containers, eventing, and cloud data platforms.
Builds installable desktop applications for Windows, macOS, Linux, or cross-platform environments.
Builds browser-based user interfaces, client-side logic, reusable components, and responsive accessible web experiences.
Builds both frontend and backend parts of web applications, including interfaces, APIs, data storage, and deployment.
Defines the structural design, technology strategy, quality attributes, patterns, standards, and evolution of software systems.
Builds low-level, performance-critical software that interacts closely with operating systems, hardware, networking, runtimes, or drivers.
Builds, tests, releases, and maintains native iOS/iPadOS applications.
Tests digital products for accessibility barriers and compliance with accessibility standards.
Tests games for gameplay defects, stability, compatibility, progression errors, performance issues, and platform requirements.
Tests interactions between services, APIs, databases, queues, devices, and external systems.
Tests translated and internationalized software for linguistic, formatting, locale, encoding, and cultural defects.
Tests system behavior under load, stress, endurance, and scalability conditions.
Plans and executes functional, regression, exploratory, system, and end-to-end software tests.
Builds coded automated testing frameworks, test suites, quality pipelines, mocks, and CI-integrated validation.
Evaluates product usability, task completion, learnability, friction, and user satisfaction.
Builds blockchain applications, smart contracts, decentralized systems, token logic, and blockchain integrations.
Builds firmware and low-level software for devices, microcontrollers, sensors, real-time systems, and embedded Linux platforms.
Implements game systems, gameplay features, tools, multiplayer capabilities, rendering interactions, and runtime code.
Builds connected-device applications across firmware, gateways, telemetry, cloud ingestion, device management, and edge-to-cloud services.
Builds and maintains software robots that automate structured, repetitive business processes across enterprise applications.
